title: Parents Night Out
seo_title: Parents Night Out at Joplin First Church of the Nazarene
description: Parents Night Out gives parents a few hours to shop, wrap gifts, have a date night, or relax while children ages 3-12 enjoy food, games, Christmas crafts, and a movie. It is free, and signing up in advance through the Facebook event or registration form is requested so the church can prepare; everyone is welcome and church attendance is not required. It runs Friday, December 11, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 9:00 PM at Joplin First Church of the Nazarene, 2124 Utica St, Joplin, MO.
